name: Back to Toad's Head
source:
A mysterious message from a missing friend calls me back to my old hometown along with two other childhood friends. Strange happenings abound as we dig deeper trying to shed light on our present.

[From [url=https://avarisharkay.itch.io/back-to-toads-head]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位失踪的朋友发来的神秘信息让我和另外两个儿时好友回到了故乡。当我们深入挖掘并试图了解我们现在的情况时，奇怪的事情比比皆是。

[来自[url=https://avarisharkay.itch.io/back-to-toads-head]Itch.io[/url]]
